decisions.reason: The client relaxes this connector's existing sourceability rule by allowing the current high-cost minimum-order option when no compatible alternative exists.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: If there is no alternative, I can order those anyway, although their cost is about 24% of the total for all the boards :)

value_updates.sourceability_requirement: Prefer a readily obtainable compatible alternative, but the current high-cost minimum-order connector may be used when no alternative exists.

decisions.reason: The connector sourcing fallback does not change the requirement to provide connector pin labels or their placement.
Accepting an expensive connector if necessary does not change the manufacturing-account access, board-upload, or cart-setup requirements.
The sourcing fallback does not alter the required BOM information or power-board manufacturing exports.
The connector sourcing decision does not alter the sensor-board BOM or production-file requirements.
Permitting the current connector when no alternative exists does not change the requested assembly-orientation review.
The source decision concerns connector procurement, not its physical placement, clearance, orientation, or board fit.
The connector sourcing fallback has no effect on the AXP2101 topology or thermal-pad requirements.
The source decision does not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment or mapping policy.
The connector procurement fallback does not change the main-board connector configuration, orientation, placement, or dimensions.
The source decision does not alter sensor-board connector placement, component arrangement, or enclosure fit.
Allowing a costly connector purchase does not change the specified interboard connector types, signals, pin-order policy, or matching-numbering requirement.
